title: COMMUNICATIONS - GENERAL
question: What is the purpose of dividing the chapter into sections such as speech communication, audio integrating system, and static discharging?
answer: Information contained in this chapter provides the basic procedures which can be accomplished at the flight line level; such as, removal and installation of components and system operation.This chapter is divided into sections to aid maintenance personnel in locating information. A brief description of each section is as follows: (1)  The speech communication section describes radio equipment used for reception and transmission of voice communication. (2)  The audio integrating system section describes that portion of the system which controls the output of the communications and navigation receivers into the pilot and passengers headphones and speakers, and the output of the pilot's microphone into the communications transmitters. (3)  The static discharging section describes the static discharge wicks used to dissipate static electricity.
